subject: Booking: ML/Infra deep dive (60-90m) — next steps and proposed agenda
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Booking: ML/Infra deep dive (60-90m) — next steps and proposed agenda

Hi Maria — great conversation earlier. Quick recap + next steps so we can lock a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML/Infra team.

Recap (2 min):
- You’re exploring inference for real-time clinical summaries + batch report generation.
- Primary constraints: P95 latency budget ~100ms, private VPC for PHI, and predictable monthly spend.

Suggested next meeting goal: 60–90 minute technical runthrough to cover architecture, data flows, privacy/residency needs, and capacity planning. We’ll bring an infra engineer and an ML serving expert.

Proposed agenda (attach v1):
- 5m quick intros and outcomes
- 15m current architecture & requirements (you + engineering lead)
- 20–30m Redwood runtime demo and model-variant discussion
- 15–20m capacity & cost tradeoffs (batching, quantization, routing)
- 10–15m Q&A, next steps, and mutual action items

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Mar 28 — 10:00–11:30am or 2:00–3:30pm
- Wed Mar 29 — 9:00–10:30am or 3:00–4:30pm

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your engineering team will join (suggest adding your infra lead + data engineer)? If those times don’t work, happy to coordinate a different window.

Pre-reads & attachments: attaching a short agenda draft (ml_infra_deepdive_agenda_v1.pdf) and a one-page pre-call checklist. Also linking a short pre-read doc.

Next step: if you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-call checklist for attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Nikhil — that summary is helpful. Alex (our Head of Infrastructure) should join; I’ve cc’d him on this reply. We’d like to prioritize the VPC / PHI discussion and any SOC2 / data residency controls you have.

Preferred times for us: Wed Mar 29, 9:00–10:30am works best (PST). If you can do 60 minutes we’d prefer that to keep it focused.

A few asks before the call:
- Can you include a brief note on deployment options (hosted vs. private) and a sample SLA?
- Any docs on encryption-at-rest and key management (KMS/HSM) would be great pre-read.

Looking forward — Maria
